en.headline: After Taste exhibition opens in Cheung Sha Wan tracing a century of Hong Kong dining
en.dek: Local studio artellex and private collectors present rare menus, calligraphic scrolls and antique cookbooks from 21 August to 27 September, by appointment only.
body: A new exhibition titled After Taste (過去味來) opens today at an industrial building in Cheung Sha Wan, using a 1902 menu as its narrative frame to explore how Hong Kong people have eaten and lived from the 1920s to the present.

Organised by local photography and printing studio artellex together with private collectors including John Wu of MODERNISM, the show is structured like a five-course banquet: menus from colonial hotels to post-war restaurants, hand-brushed calligraphic “zi-tau” from classic Chinese restaurants, antique cookbooks, Mid-Autumn mooncake artefacts and more.

The exhibition runs from 21 August to 27 September, closed on Mondays, daily from noon to 7 p.m. at Room 204A, 2/F, New Cheong Industrial Building, 1–3 Cheung Shun Street. Entry is by appointment only via the organiser’s booking system.

zh.headline: 《過去味來》長沙灣開展 重現香港百年飲食演變
zh.dek: 本地工作室artellex聯同私人收藏家展出珍稀餐牌、書法字頭及古籍食譜，8月21日至9月27日舉行，需預約參觀。
body: 名為《過去味來》的展覽今日起於長沙灣一幢工業大廈開幕，以一份1902年的餐牌為敘事骨架，回顧香港人由1920年代至今的飲食與生活面貌。
展覽由本地攝影及打印工作室artellex聯同包括MODERNISM胡兆昌在內的私人收藏家呈獻，仿照完整菜牌分為五個部分，展出殖民地時期酒店餐牌、戰後酒樓印刷菜單、經典酒家毛筆書寫「字頭」、食譜古籍及中秋餅具等。
展期由8月21日至9月27日，逢星期一休息，每日正午至晚上7時於長沙灣長順街1-3號新昌工業大廈2樓204A室舉行，需透過主辦方預約系統預約參觀。
